correctness.rationale: Binary adjacency parity gives exact two-child state recurrences. All eight states are reached in four steps from every state and each has two incoming transitions, implying uniform frequency 1/8 in a primitive 2-uniform substitution. The exact length-16 binary block identity reduces all length-1-to-16 factors to 128 state/residue cases, each of density 1/128. The complete finite table is replayed by a standalone no-dependency verifier; lengths 15 and 16 have no palindrome, proving every longer length empty by central-factor arguments. Counts, densities, and high-length start positions agree in all exact cases; large-prefix tests are supplemental.

value.rationale: An exact natural frequency for every word in a complete palindromic factor language is a meaningful finite classification of an infinite automatic dynamical system, not a single arbitrarily chosen length. The equality of frequencies for all palindromes at the same length is a nontrivial structural property absent for general factors and not implied by their number or maximal length. Explicit start residues and eight-state conditions provide reproducible occurrence information for all 36 factors and can be used in weighted word sampling and combinatorial factor search.
